US Judge Blocks Trump Policies on Foreign Students and Journalists

A U.S. judge has blocked the Trump administration's restrictions on foreign student internships and visa access for journalists. The judge described the administration's actions as 'arbitrary and capricious.' Separately, a study indicated that fewer foreign students are studying at U.S. universities due to Trump administration policies. In a different aviation-related event, over 12,000 flights were cancelled in the U.S., with former President Trump blaming President Biden for a nationwide aviation crisis. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is reportedly rethinking its upgrade processes but requires additional funding, and scrutiny of the FAA has intensified following a communications meltdown that led to a nationwide grounding of flights.
